newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-AUSTRALIA NAMES FED CUP TEAM TO PLAY SPAIN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-AUSTRALIA NAMES FED CUP TEAM TO PLAY SPAIN.

text.p: Australia said on Thursday its Fed Cup tennis team to take on Spain later this month would be unchanged from the quartet which scored a surprise win over South Africa in March.
Captain Lesley Bowrey named the team for the World Group playoff as Annabel Ellwood, Kerry-Anne Guse, Kristine Kunce and Rachel McQuillan.
Spain's quartet will be former world number one Arantxa Sanchez Vicario, Maria Luisa Serna, Virginia Ruano-Pascual and Maria Antonia Sanchez Lorenzo.
The two countries will meet at Hope Island in Queensland state on July 12-13 for the right to remain in World Group One and compete for the 1998 Fed Cup.
Spain has reached the final of the prestigious women's team event in seven of the last eight years, winning in 1991, 1993, 1994 and 1995.
"We may be going in as underdogs on paper, but these girls have demonstrated that they can rise to the occasion and match the game of higher ranked players," said Bowrey.
